title: DDPT: Enhancing complex reasoning in large language models via distillation and dynamic prompt tuning
selection_reason: Relevant to LLM inference: beyond parameter-efficient prompt tuning during adaptation, DDPT changes test-time execution by routing each query to a specialized soft prompt using similarity and using a soft-prompt verifier with majority voting to filter generated reasoning paths. The paper reports an average accuracy gain of 8.39% over 100-token prompt tuning at comparable parameter count and performance above LoRA with fewer parameters; it does not establish inference latency or throughput gains, so acceptance is for inference reasoning behavior rather than serving-speed improvement.
